Name: LMGT3 Porsche 911 GT3 R
Author: Redadeg (lmu-dashboards.com)
Description: Converted for the FX Pro by N.P from Redadeg's SimHub dash "LMGT3 Porsche 911 GT3 R - standard size DDU" (https://lmu-dashboards.com). Three pages (Next page 1): race, race with the virtual energy bar, qualifying with the delta bar. Pop-ups for TC, ABS, engine map and brake bias changes, the pit limiter and pit stop, the race start, a lap summary per session, and alarms for low energy and a flat tyre (put away with Next page 2 and 3). Runs best with the screen's RAM drive (Wheel tab).
